report.summary: For 2026, the soundbar market is dominated by full 11.1.4 systems like the Samsung HW-Q990F for true Atmos, compact all-in-ones like Sonos Beam Gen 2 for most living rooms, and ultra-budget picks like Hisense HS2100. Hands-on testing by TechRadar and RTINGS confirms dialogue clarity, immersion, and HDMI eARC/4K 120Hz passthrough are the real differentiators, not marketing wattage.

products.name: Samsung HW-Q990F
pros: RTINGS hands-on testing names it best soundbar for dialogue — premium 11.1.4 system ideal for movies and mixed usage
Full surround package with wireless subwoofer and rear speakers for real home theater audio, not virtualized
Supports Dolby Atmos and eARC with HDMI passthrough for 4K 120Hz setups per TechRadar buying criteria
cons: Large footprint and higher price than all-in-one bars — overkill for small rooms
Requires space for rear speakers and subwoofer placement, more complex setup than single-bar options
products.verdict: The consensus pick for 2026 if you want true surround. Hands-on testing by RTINGS confirms it as best for dialogue, and expert-domain lists from PCMag Australia and ExpertReviews rank it as best premium Atmos system. It's the bar to beat for large rooms.

products.name: Sonos Beam (Gen 2)
pros: Named Best soundbar overall by ExpertReviews and top budget Atmos pick by What HiFi in 2026 lists
Compact all-in-one design that mounts below TV or on shelf, with smart speaker voice control
Strong community and expert-domain coverage for natural sound and speech clarity
cons: No dedicated wireless subwoofer included — bass limited vs bar+sub systems
No HDMI 2.1 4K 120Hz passthrough, relies on TV eARC for Atmos
products.verdict: The safe all-rounder for most people. Multiple expert-domain sources in 2026 (ExpertReviews, What HiFi, PCMag) list it as best overall or best budget Atmos, and TechRadar's hands-on framework emphasizes its balance of natural sound, dialogue clarity, and ease of use.

products.name: Hisense HS2100
pros: RTINGS expert-domain review calls it best-value soundbar tested at around $100 price point
Ideal for small or medium rooms to enhance TV sound without separate receiver
Simple setup with integrated electronics connecting directly to TV
cons: Inexpensive build with less power and fewer features than separate component systems
No true Dolby Atmos height effects or wireless rear speakers
products.verdict: If you want to spend as little as possible, this is the verified pick. RTINGS hands-on testing specifically highlights it as best-value at $100, unlike listicle-only budget bars with no independent measurements. Expect clear upgrade over TV speakers, not room-filling theater.

products.name: KEF XIO
pros: StereoNET Editor's Choice and Product of the Year 2026 Winner for premium soundbars
Audiophile-grade build with metal construction and quality components per premium tier criteria
Positioned as best premium soundbar above mass-market Atmos bars
cons: Very high price at $2,500 USD / £1,999 — 10x budget options
Limited hands-on data in provided sources beyond award listing — fewer measurements than Samsung/Sonos
products.verdict: For premium buyers who want audiophile brand cachet over Samsung's surround package. StereoNET's 2026 list gives it top honors, but note this is listicle-based with less hands-on depth than RTINGS/TechRadar picks — treat rating as provisional and audition first.

products.name: Sonos Arc Ultra
pros: Listed by PCMag Australia and RTINGS as tested flagship single-bar with Dolby Atmos
Expandable with Era 300s and Sub for 13.1.6-style wireless surround per LG Sound Suite comparisons
Strong ecosystem with Wi-Fi, AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect support noted in 2026 wireless trend coverage
cons: Missing DTS support noted in community hands-on comparisons as of early 2026
Premium price without included subwoofer or rears — full system costs significantly more
products.verdict: Best single-bar Atmos if you don't want rear boxes day one. Expert-domain lists consistently include it alongside HW-Q990F, and community reports praise pairing with Era 300s. Only listicle and affiliate-linked mentions support some claims, so confidence is lower than Samsung HW-Q990F which has RTINGS dialogue measurements.
